claims.claim: First story is 'A Scandal in Bohemia'; opens with Watson recalling Irene Adler, 'the woman' to Holmes
claims.evidence: 'To Sherlock Holmes she is always the woman'; 'the late Irene Adler'
'My marriage had drifted us away'; 'Wedlock suits you'

claims.claim: Watson visits his old friend at 221B Baker Street
claims.evidence: Baker Street and the rooms found; '221B' not in the text; Watson passes by on a chance night walk
claims.fix: Watson, passing Baker Street one night, calls on his old friend.

claims.claim: Holmes deduces his visitor's business from a note
claims.evidence: Holmes first deduces Watson's marriage and return to practice; then from the unsigned note's paper (Gesellschaft, Bohemia) deduces its writer is a German from Bohemia; the note only announces a visitor
claims.fix: Holmes deduces from the paper of an unsigned note that its writer is a German from Bohemia.

claims.claim: Twelve cases told by Dr. Watson
King of Bohemia hires Holmes to retrieve a photograph from Irene Adler, who outwits him
claims.evidence: 'My photograph.'; 'plans of Mr. Sherlock Holmes were beaten by a woman's wit'

claims.claim: Red-Headed League is a cover for a bank robbery
claims.evidence: Pawnbroker's business at Coburg Square; John Clay; Merryweather, bank director

claims.claim: Beggar Hugh Boone is the missing Neville St. Clair
claims.evidence: 'His name is Hugh Boone'; 'Neville St. Clair has entered it never...'

claims.claim: Stolen blue carbuncle traced to a goose
Holmes defeats Dr. Roylott in the Speckled Band
claims.evidence: 'Dr. Grimesby Roylott' of Stoke Moran; story VIII

claims.claim: Holmes helps the Engineer, the Noble Bachelor and the Beryl Coronet; ends at the Copper Beeches
Dr. John Watson: friend and flatmate, who narrates
claims.evidence: 'John' appears only as other people; text says 'Dr. Watson'; 'flatmate' now married, lodging in Baker Street no longer his
claims.fix: Dr. Watson: Holmes's friend, who narrates

claims.claim: Holmes: consulting detective of Baker Street
claims.evidence: 'remained in our lodgings in Baker Street'

claims.claim: Irene Adler adventuress who outwits Holmes in the first story
claims.evidence: 'the late Irene Adler, of dubious and questionable memory'

claims.claim: Lestrade: Scotland Yard detective who calls on Holmes
claims.evidence: 'I had no difficulty in recognising Lestrade, of Scotland Yard' waiting at Ross station in Boscombe Valley; he does not call on Holmes
claims.fix: a Scotland Yard detective who meets Holmes and Watson at Ross in the Boscombe Valley case
